description: Curated cross-reactivity groups, consumed alongside any drug-reference source (json, atc or ddinter). ATC classification cannot express cross-branch pharmacological cross-reactivity — aspirin (N02BA01, salicylates) and ibuprofen (M01AE01, propionic-acid derivatives) sit in different ATC branches yet share the NSAID hypersensitivity family — so that linkage is carried here as data (the boundary documented in ADR Decision 24, closed by this file). A group links every drug whose ATC code falls under any of its atcPrefixes; the safety validator warns when a checked drug shares a group with a recorded allergy (cross-reactivity) or with an active order (additive / duplicate-class therapy), and the injector treats group-related active orders as relevant to a drug-specific question. Seed data — expand per deployment.

groups.name: NSAID
groups.note: Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs: hypersensitivity commonly cross-reacts across chemically distinct NSAID branches, including salicylates
